# Word-weaving

A plan is read by someone who was not there. So it says what is true, what is left, and what
is needed — in that order, in short paragraphs.

## The craft

One idea per paragraph. A literal fact — a path, a port, an error string — sits inside the
sentence, quoted once. Buttons and bullets are for the places a list truly is a list.

## Template

- `templates/plan.md` — the shape of a plan.
